candidates.source_description: When Lu Asey Keanna Oyao’s family couldn’t afford to rent a ball gown for her junior-senior prom, her brother Maverick Francisco Oyao decided to make one for her himself. A Culture and Arts Education student in Zamboanga City, Maverick had never made a dress before, so he turned to YouTube and Google for guidance and found inspiration in Filipino designer Michael Cinco.
